programs.title: Khoya Khoya Chand
programs.desc: A period drama about the lives, love, and struggles of actors in the Hindi film industry of the 1950s.

programs.title: Aankhen
programs.desc: When Vijay Singh Rajput is unceremoniously stripped of his duties as a bank manager, he decides to seek revenge by robbing the bank. To make the robbery untraceable, he trains three blind men to do the job for him.

programs.title: Pyare Mohan
programs.desc: A blind man Pyare and his deaf friend Mohan fall in love with twin sisters Preeti and Priya. But their relationships spiral into chaos when the sisters get falsely implicated in a murder case and the men have to find a way to save them.

programs.title: Ek Chalis Ki Last Local
programs.desc: Nilesh is a call centre executive who misses his last local train at 1:40 am. He meets Madhu, who also misses the train. Since there is an auto strike, they decide to take a walk. The duo then attend a bar that changes their life upside down.

programs.title: Bollywood Movie
programs.desc: The Movie Club +2 broadcasts Bollywood and popular Indian cinema on a two-hour time-shifted delay, allowing viewers to catch missed movies on India's free ad-supported streaming platforms.
